probe.summary: Attribution probe (`probes/closingB_disputes_registry.py`, 44ace5079160 section): the claim's cited lines (registry.py:44-45) are the ROLES tuple — registry.py contains no assertion. The assertion in this region is real but lives at core.py:3250-3271, and it is the Tech Lead BOUNDARY assertion (four-disputed solution §3): at the point an adjudication would be recorded, the selected seat must satisfy the shared eligibility predicate against the finding's actual raiser and refuter; on failure the code records an assertion_failure entry, marks the Tech Lead unavailable, and routes the case to the owner — 'fail CLOSED... never proceed with the seat'. That is the opposite of a lenient fallback: it is the fail-closed routing the design mandates, quoted from the code's own comment.
